content.title: Wells sees potential upside after Glaukos’ iDose repeat dosing label approved
content.summary: Wells Fargo notes that Glaukos (GKOS) has announced FDA approval of its repeat dosing label for iDose, in line with the firm’s expectations. Label appears broad though with some corneal-safety limits. Overall, Wells views this as supportive of the long-term iDose annuity model. The firm has an Overweight rating on the shares with a price target of $122.
